headline_fact: US annual inflation slowed to 3.4% in July 2026, down from 3.5% in June -- the second straight monthly slowdown -- with the consumer price index up 0.1% for the month and core CPI (excluding food and energy) up 0.2%. Released August 12, 2026.
narration_script: According to CNBC (Bureau of Labor Statistics data), US inflation slowed in July 2026, with the annual rate at 3.4% compared to 3.5% in June.
on_screen_text: US Inflation Slows to 3.4% in July
